description: Cloud communications platform providing APIs for messaging, voice, email, and verification
auth_notes: HTTP Basic authentication using Account SID and Auth Token, or API Key SID and Secret.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free trial account instantly with no credit card required to obtain API credentials.
api_notes: Comprehensive APIs covering SMS, MMS, WhatsApp, Voice, Video, Verify, Lookup, TaskRouter, and Serverless functions.
mcp_notes: No official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Twilio.
rationale: Twilio offers a fully documented public REST API with immediate self-serve trial credentials and comprehensive client SDKs.

evidence.note: Describes Twilio REST API request principles, authentication, and HTTP usage.
Indicates sign up for a free trial account with no credit card required to get started.
Lists extensive API reference documentation across messaging, voice, video, authentication, and builder tools.
Official GitHub organization showing helper libraries, CLI, and SDKs, but no official MCP server.
